goal: Make the opt-in learned Bayer demosaic cheap enough that only quality decides whether it becomes the default
notes: learned_map rewritten as a 3-stage row pipeline over 8-row rings (no band-sized feature planes), interior loops vectorized via restrict row functions, library built -O3 -ffp-contract=off. Seven real frames (70D, D810, A7 III, E-M10, K-1 II, A7 IV, 7D): equal to numpy bit for bit; learned now 1.5-2.0x the default's time (was 2.6-3.3x); same-hour before/after 1.35->0.73 s (A7 III) and 2.43->1.31 s (K-1 II) on 4 CPUs. tests/test_bayer_native.py + test_bayer_demosaic.py: 23 passed; ruff clean; run_venture_tests.py photo-editing: ok, 1220 tests, 8 skipped, 0 failed (158 s).
